title: The Pets.com Crash (example)
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pets.com (IPO Feb 2000 raised $82.5M; Super Bowl XXXIV ad $1.2M; stock $0.19 on Nov 7, 2000)

lines.text: Pets.com raised eighty-two million dollars on the stock market.
It spent one point two million on one Super Bowl ad,
But it sold pet food for less than it paid.
Nine months later, the stock was worth nineteen cents,
